title: Lift Ticket Tariff, Season 2026-27
content:
Granite Ridge Mountain Collective sells Lift Tickets for the 2026-27 season at the rates below. Every product in the line is sold for that season and for no other.

| Product | Window price | Advance price | Advance period | Block price | Days in block | Holiday surcharge | Payment point |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Granite Ridge Window Day Ticket | USD 219.00 | USD 219.00 | 0 days | USD 219.00 | 1 | USD 0.00 | at collection |
| Granite Ridge 3-Day Advance Ticket | USD 219.00 | USD 189.00 | 3 days | USD 189.00 | 1 | USD 25.00 | at the order |
| Granite Ridge 7-Day Advance Ticket | USD 219.00 | USD 164.00 | 7 days | USD 164.00 | 1 | USD 35.00 | at the order |
| Granite Ridge Flex 4-Day Ticket Pack | USD 219.00 | USD 149.00 | 7 days | USD 596.00 | 4 | USD 45.00 | at the order |
| Granite Ridge Flex 8-Day Ticket Pack | USD 219.00 | USD 134.00 | 14 days | USD 1072.00 | 8 | USD 45.00 | at the order |
| Granite Ridge Collective Multi-Mountain Ticket Pack | USD 239.00 | USD 152.00 | 14 days | USD 1216.00 | 8 | USD 0.00 | at the order |

## Notes on the columns

1. **Window price** is the price of one day of the product bought at the ticket window on the day.
2. **Advance price** is the price of one day of the product bought at least the advance period ahead.
3. **Advance period** is the fewest calendar days ahead of the ski date the product must be bought to take the advance price. The Granite Ridge Window Day Ticket carries an advance period of 0 days, and its window and advance rates stand alike at USD 219.00.
4. **Block price** is the price of the whole block of days the product is sold as.
5. **Days in block** is the number of ski days one order of the product holds. The three day products hold a single day each; the Granite Ridge Flex 4-Day Ticket Pack holds 4, and the Granite Ridge Flex 8-Day Ticket Pack and the Granite Ridge Collective Multi-Mountain Ticket Pack hold 8 apiece.
6. **Holiday surcharge** is the amount added to each day of the product scanned inside a published holiday period. The Granite Ridge Window Day Ticket and the Granite Ridge Collective Multi-Mountain Ticket Pack carry none.
7. **Payment point** is when the order is collected: at the order, or when the media is collected. The Granite Ridge Window Day Ticket alone is collected at the media counter; every other product in the line is collected at the order.
